title: OutageActivityRecommendation
description: Stage G output. Final recommendation artifact for an emergent outage activity. Synthesizes all upstream pipeline outputs into an actionable, evidence-backed recommendation for the outage manager. Designed as a traceable audit trail: every claim cites a source, every regulatory flag is surfaced, and analysts can reject with reason. This is the artifact the outage manager reads.

recommendation_id.description: Stable unique identifier for this recommendation. Format: REC::{activity_id}::{uuid}.

decision_status.description: PROCEED: execute the recommended option. DEFER: defer to post-outage or next cycle. ESCALATE: risk or regulatory complexity requires management decision. MONITOR: no immediate action, but flag for continued observation. INCONCLUSIVE: insufficient data to recommend — analyst review required.

primary_conclusion.description: One or two sentence plain-language summary for the outage manager.

confidence_tier.description: data_supported: recommendation backed by ≥5 analogs and solid schedule data. sme_informed: based on limited analogs or SME-adjusted estimates. low_confidence: minimal historical data — treat as a watch item.

primary_recommendation.description: The top-ranked feasible, regulatory-cleared option from InsertionOptions.

rationale.description: Evidence-backed rationale citing specific analogs, chain links, and schedule analysis.

regulatory_flags.description: All regulatory constraints identified in Stage A, surfaced here for the outage manager. Any DEFER or ESCALATE recommendation with regulatory flags present must be reviewed by licensing before action.

evidence_chain.description: The specific pieces of evidence backing this recommendation. Designed for the evidence drilldown view. Every claim in the recommendation should have at least one entry here.

source_id.description: Identifier of the source record (e.g., CR number, analog_id, link_id).

snippet.description: Relevant text or data excerpt from the source.

supports.description: True if this evidence supports the recommendation; false if it contradicts or qualifies it.

history_summary.description: Summary of what the historical record shows for this component and activity type.

recurrence_pattern.description: e.g., 'Component has had 3 corrective maintenance events in the last 2 cycles, trend increasing.'

schedule_summary.description: Key schedule impact figures for the executive view.

has_displaced_regulatory_tasks.description: True if any displaced task has a regulatory constraint.

required.description: True if analyst review is required before this recommendation can be acted upon (e.g., regulatory constraints present, low confidence, or INCONCLUSIVE decision status).

reviewer_decision.description: Populated after analyst review. Part of the human-in-the-loop feedback loop.

reviewer_notes.description: Free-text notes from the reviewing analyst. Feeds back into the learning loop.

all_regulatory_flags_resolved.description: True if every regulatory_flag has been acknowledged in the recommendation logic.

minimum_evidence_met.description: True if the evidence_chain contains at least one supporting entry.

fallback_used.description: True if any upstream stage used a fallback (e.g., population-level duration, no analog data).

provenance.description: Full traceability of all input artifacts used to produce this recommendation.
